resources.string: Opens Android controls. Turn on Bluetooth tethering there, then return here.
Use the Bluetooth tethering switch in Android. Opening settings does not turn sharing on.
Direct tethering controls are unavailable on this phone. In network settings, open Hotspot & tethering → Bluetooth tethering.
Open Hotspot & tethering or Mobile Hotspot and Tethering in Android Settings, then enable Bluetooth tethering.
Android settings could not open. Open phone Settings manually and look for Bluetooth tethering.
